answer: We buy cars that don't run. Some stores will tow your car to the store for free, and your offer page shows which stores near you offer towing. Home pickup isn't available for cars that don't run. The specialist confirms the offer after inspecting the car at the store. You don't need a payoff letter, because Meridian Auto Loans is in our e-payoff network. We check your payoff directly with Meridian the same day, at your appointment, using your loan account number, so bring that number with you.
